shared_elements: carved pale limestone surface in low relief
upright anthropomorphic figure carved in relief (small standing figure at lower left in B, figure with raised arms in A)
sunlit excavated stone in an archaeological setting
justification: Both show pale, sun-lit stone worked in shallow relief and organised by roughly horizontal bands, and each includes at least one small upright anthropomorphic figure low on the surface, which is the most specific correspondence. The difference is decisive, however: A is a discrete free-standing slab densely covered with crisp, legible animal and human motifs in stacked registers, whereas B is a broad eroded wall face whose surface is mostly weathered texture with only faint, barely readable incised rows and a couple of degraded figures at its base.
